summary: Contestants demonstrate their knowledge and skills in ethics, law, business law, and personal law by taking an objective test. The event is open to any secondary or postsecondary division contestant. Contestants may use non-electronic written reference materials during the event.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes orientation
no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
no more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non -electronic written reference materials
competencies: Understand legal terminology, including Latin terms, and office procedures accurately in documents and communications to ensure efficiency and compliance in a modern legal environment
Analyze and navigate court structures and proceedings while applying ethical standards to ensure compliance and uphold professional integrity
Demonstrate an understanding of self -awareness and effective communication with a diverse workforce to foster an inclusive and professional legal environment
Demonstrate an understanding of sound judgment and decision -making skills to meet or exceed legal workplace standards and expectations
judging_notes: Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
